title: Ned Digs a Gift
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds l, ll, ss
note_for_grown_ups: At only 12 sounds the giving itself has to be shown in the picture rather than written — a good chance to talk about what is happening on pages 6 and 7 together.

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling digging with his beak in a gravel path.
Ned pulling a small shiny bottle cap out of the gravel, delighted.

pages.text: Ned sat. Ned did tap it.
pages.illustration: Ned sitting on the path, tapping dirt off the shiny cap with his beak.
Nell the bee landing nearby on a low fence post, watching Ned.

pages.text: Ned sat. Ned and Nell sat.
pages.illustration: Ned and Nell sitting together on the gravel path, the clean cap between them.
Nell the bee holding the clean, shiny cap, delighted, while Ned looks on proudly.

pages.text: Ned did nap. Nell did nap.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling and Nell the bee both dozing contentedly side by side on the gravel path.
